## 📌 Pull Request Overview

### Summary of Changes
Provide a concise overview of what was added, changed, or fixed.

### 🔗 Related Issue
Fixes #(issue number)

---

## 🧪 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring / Code cleanup
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Test coverage improvement

---

## 📋 Verification Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's Java 25 & Spring Boot conventions.
- [ ] I have executed `./mvnw clean test` locally and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have added new unit or integration tests covering my changes.
- [ ] I have updated the `README.md` (or relevant documentation) if applicable.
- [ ] I have tested this manually with Ollama running locally.
